purpose: Gradient accumulation loss scaling: sam3/train/trainer.py _run_step must scale ONLY the backward loss by 1/accum_steps when gradient_accumulation_steps > 1, so accumulating N micro-batch gradients equals the gradient of the MEAN loss over those micro-batches (true effective-batch semantics at unchanged learning rate). Logged losses and the finite-check keep the raw unscaled value; optimizer/scheduler/clipping timing is unchanged; accum=1 is bit-for-bit identical. Without this patch, accum>1 sums gradients (~N x magnitude).
